collection.description: A villager learns that a close friend does not return their romantic feelings.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (villager) learns that (friend), a close friend, does not return their romantic feelings.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The two preserve their friendship with a little time.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (villager) takes some space and feels steadier afterward.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Both understand how to remain comfortable together.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They agree to spend less time alone for a while.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (villager) enjoys some quiet time before socializing again.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A new hobby helps (villager) feel hopeful.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The hobby becomes rewarding even without a new romance.
